details:
Basically, on my Quest 2 while hooked up to the PC via Virtual Desktop, I've sometimes run into an issue where I am in the Launch Pad or other main VRC menu and go to click on something, like an avatar, a tab or even a world, my clicks fail to be registered by the menu while my gestures keep going, indicating that the game IS registering my presses, just not doing anything with them. My only current solution is to spam click on things with both controllers until it eventually registers my input, which can take up to a minute or so.

Typically happens when I've been in VRC for two hours minimum.

This can pose as a big issue for time sensitive events, like clubs or hanging out with people who have limited free time.

My current control scheme is the default, 'cept I set it so that clicking the left joystick lets me move my playspace, and clicking the right one resets that.

I will try to supply footage the next time it happens.
title: Main VRC Menu Fails to Respond to Button Presses Sometimes, While Gestures Still Activate.
